attempt_selection.rule: attempt_001 only for primary complete-run pairs; no automatic best/latest/retry selection

paired_design.independent_aggregation_unit: specified layout, not arm, prefix, route, surface sample or object

coverage.denominator: frozen scene evaluator_truth reachable boolean cells from cold start
coverage.primary_A95_A100: first paid action reaching correct-free fraction >= 0.95 / 1.0 including initial action 0
coverage.unreached: null; right-censor at executed paid_actions, no imputed 256
coverage.per_action_provenance: saved scalar receipts checked for contiguous steps and threshold chronology; final belief independently remeasured; raw per-step maps not recreated

native_surface.source: four frozen scene/evaluator_references/* fixed_visible source references
native_surface.distance: float32 source points to native TSDF triangles

audits: all critical final artifact hashes and immutable source freeze
same cold initial packet/budget/reference within layout
all acquired frame receipt count/order/hash chain
no probability pruning or geometry collapse
independent B9 T16 posterior recomputation, shared G/S observed geometry likelihood bank
acquisition all actual past frames, no candidate modification
limitations: Per-frame receipt integrity is verified, not independent rereading of all raw frames.
Frozen actor interface/source review and declaration audit are not an OS filesystem trace.
Four new layouts use ideal masks, exact poses and noise-free synthetic sensors; no robot or natural detector validation.
Shared three-process runtime is not an isolated realtime benchmark.
Negative changes, tied paths, failures, partial attempts and unreached thresholds all retained.

compatibility_case.purpose: software metric compatibility, not a new experiment
compatibility_case.expected: all nested native metric values exact versus existing frozen B10 result
